translated_title: Sheinbaum Criticizes La Derecha Diario Following Cerimedo’s Arrest
original_title: Sheinbaum critica a La Derecha Diario tras detención de Cerimedo
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
meta_description: At her morning conference, President Sheinbaum accused La Derecha Diario—co-founded by the arrested Fernando Cerimedo and Javier Negre—of using bots, AI, and fake news to sway Latin American elections, and said Ricardo Salinas Pliego hired its operators.
